verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills drives YYLO Ledger records, which hold user data, so data residency is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no region or residency selection. The only location-related item is registering a local project path for command routing, which is an adjacent feature, not a choice of where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
